opened_originals.scope: Original reduced-power formula and sphere obstruction opened visually. For complex rank six on a smooth manifold homeomorphic to S^12, lower Chern classes vanish and c6=2u. At p=5 the splitting-principle calculation gives P^1(c2)=s5*s1-s6=6*c6 modulo the lower-Chern ideal, contradicting 0=2u modulo 5. Proposition 15.1 excludes almost complex S^(2n) for n>=4; the following remark explicitly covers every differentiable structure. It therefore also applies to S^24.

opened_originals.scope: The exact Bott-integrality corollary was opened visually: for a complex bundle over S^(2n), its nth Chern class is divisible by (n-1)!.
